# Third-party assets

Kinetic Forge uses these assets from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com), released under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): public domain, free for any use, attribution not required.
They are credited here with thanks.

Textures are repacked for URP Lit: `_albedo.jpg` (color), `_normal.jpg` (OpenGL normal) and `_mask.png`
(metallic in R, ambient occlusion in G, smoothness = 1 - roughness in A).
